tha-ap473:1.1: Sālapupphiyavaggo sattacattārīso. XLVIII [468. Naḷamāliya.] Suvaṇṇavaṇṇaṃ sambuddham ahutīnaṃ paṭiggahaṃ / pavanaggena gacchantaṃ addasaṃ lokanāyakaṃ. // //
tha-ap473:2.1: *Naḷamālaṃ gahetvāna nikkhamanto va tāvade / tatth' addasāsiṃ sambuddhaṃ oghatiṇṇaṃ aṇāsavaṃ. // //
tha-ap473:3.1: Pasannacitto sumano naḷamālaṃ apūjayiṃ / dakkhiṇeyyaṃ mahāvīraṃ sabbalokānukampakaṃ.* // //
tha-ap473:4.1: Ekatiṃse ito kappe yaṃ puppham abhiropayiṃ / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi Buddhapūjāy' idaṃ phalaṃ.
tha-ap473:8.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Naḷamāliyo thero i. g. a-ti.
